1.e4 e5 2.f4 f5 3.exf5 exf4 4.Nf3 d5 5.d.strategy: Develops and guards the f5 pawn, so taking it now just loses a bishop for a pawn. Both sides hold a pawn on the fifth and fourth rank in mirrored set-ups, and the game turns on who finishes development and breaks in the centre first.
1.e4 e5 2.f4 f5 3.exf5 exf4 4.Nf3 d5 5.d.name: King's Gambit Declined: Panteldakis Countergambit, Symmetrical Variation
